about: How each baseline model of the Models tab was made, in a few sentences (model_data.baseline_summary): keyed '<its experiment's folder>/<its tag>', the folder's path on tensor or its last part; paragraphs apart by a blank line.

summaries.E13_bouton_coincidence/bouton_base:
The bouton base of the KC-remapping experiments: the hemibrain mushroom body, each KC with its claws as the connectome has them, each claw fed by the PN bouton it contacts. APL's weights are the connectome's too: onto and from each claw (APL<>KC) and onto and from each PN bouton (APL<>bouton), so APL is driven by the claws' input (whether or not the KC spikes) and by the boutons, and inhibits both.

Its somatic threshold and APL weight scales were tuned so that 5 % of KC-odor pairs respond with APL on (a response: 2 or more spikes). Its APL-off run keeps that threshold and sets APL's outputs to zero. Input: ORN responses to the 16 APL16 odors (paa, -aPine and euc at the nearest concentration measured).

Made again from pyolfsysm's definition of it, as a check on the archived one (E13).
The KC-remapping experiments' reference model: the bouton base with four additions. Each claw's input passes a 40 Hz per-claw threshold; the input from eight glomeruli (D, DC2, DL1, DM1, DM5, DP1m, VA7m, VC1) is scaled by 1.5; APL's inhibition of each KC is weighted by how broadly that KC responds (breadth exponent 2); and KCs inhibit each other (KC-KC lateral inhibition).

Its somatic threshold and its APL->KC, APL->bouton (at most 3 times the base's) and KC-KC scales were fitted together to the KC data's odor-odor distances and structure statistics, with 6.8 % of KC-odor pairs responding with APL on, the control flies' rate. It is run from its saved wiring and weights.
summaries.E67_apl_effect_fits/rate0.068_aplboth_k2:
The breadth-2 APL-effect fit: the bouton base with APL's inhibition of each KC weighted by how broadly that KC responds (breadth exponent 2) and KC-KC lateral inhibition, without a glomerulus gain or a per-claw threshold.

Its somatic threshold and its APL->KC, APL->bouton (at most 3 times the base's) and KC-KC scales were fitted to the per-pair APL effect on odor-odor distances (APL on minus APL off, on raw spike counts and under a saturating readout together), with 6.8 % of KC-odor pairs responding with APL on and the APL-off / APL-on ratio near the flies'. It is run from its saved wiring and weights.
summaries.olfdb_baselines/uniform_glomeruli_claws_:
The bouton base with a random wiring and flat APL weights. Each KC gets 7 claws; each claw's glomerulus is drawn with equal chance from all glomeruli, then the claw takes a random bouton of that glomerulus (seed 0). So no glomerulus is favoured, as the connectome favours some. The draw is over all 54 hemibrain glomeruli with boutons, of which only 36 have ORN input for the APL16 odors, so about a third of its claws get no odor input, only their PNs' spontaneous firing.

Every claw's KC<>APL weights and every bouton's PN<>APL weights are equal (mean 1, as the base's connectome weights are scaled), so APL inhibits all KCs and boutons alike. Everything else is as in the bouton base: tuned to 5 % of KC-odor pairs responding with APL on, then run with APL's outputs at zero.
summaries.olfdb_baselines/shuffled_connectome_pair:
The bouton base with its connectome shuffled (seed 0). The claws, boutons and total weights are the connectome's, but which bouton feeds each claw is shuffled across all claws, and so is how much each claw gets from and gives to APL, and (across boutons) how much each bouton does.

A claw's (or bouton's) APL->X and X->APL weights are moved together, so a site that gets much from APL still gives much to it. Everything else is as in the bouton base: tuned to 5 % of KC-odor pairs responding with APL on, then run with APL's outputs at zero.

The bouton base with its connectome shuffled (seed 0), as in shuffled_connectome_pairs_kept_seed0, but each claw's (and bouton's) APL->X and X->APL weights are shuffled independently.

So how much a site gets from APL no longer goes with how much it gives to APL. Everything else is as in the bouton base: tuned to 5 % of KC-odor pairs responding with APL on, then run with APL's outputs at zero.
summaries.olfdb_baselines/bouton_base_input_glomer:
The bouton base restricted to the glomeruli in the model's ORN input (36 for the APL16 odors). The boutons of the other glomeruli, the claws fed only by them and KCs left with no claws are dropped. With the APL16 input it keeps 36 of 54 glomeruli, 307 of 389 boutons, 8188 of 9867 claws and 1700 of 1732 KCs. In the bouton base those claws give KCs their PNs' spontaneous firing and take part in APL's input and output.

So here KCs lose that spontaneous drive, APL neither hears from nor inhibits those claws and boutons, and the remaining APL weights are scaled to mean 1 among themselves. Odor input is unchanged. Tuned to 5 % responding with APL on, then run with APL's outputs at zero, as the bouton base.
summaries.olfdb_baselines/uniform_glomeruli_claws_:
The bouton base with a random wiring and flat APL weights, as uniform_glomeruli_claws_uniform_apl, but restricted to the glomeruli in the model's ORN input (36 for the APL16 odors). Each KC gets 7 claws; each claw's glomerulus is drawn with equal chance from those 36 only, then a random bouton of it (seed 0), so every claw gets odor input.

Every claw's KC<>APL weights and every bouton's PN<>APL weights are equal (mean 1). Everything else is as in the bouton base: tuned to 5 % of KC-odor pairs responding with APL on, then run with APL's outputs at zero.
summaries.olfdb_baselines/shuffled_connectome_pair:
The bouton base with its connectome shuffled (seed 0), as shuffled_connectome_pairs_kept_seed0, but restricted to the glomeruli in the model's ORN input (36 for the APL16 odors). The boutons of the other glomeruli and the claws fed only by them are dropped first, so only claws and boutons with odor input are shuffled, and APL weights are scaled to mean 1 among them.

Which bouton feeds each claw is shuffled across claws, and so is how much each claw and each bouton gets from and gives to APL. A claw's (or bouton's) APL->X and X->APL weights are moved together. Everything else is as in the bouton base: tuned to 5 % of KC-odor pairs responding with APL on, then run with APL's outputs at zero.

The bouton base with its connectome shuffled (seed 0), as shuffled_connectome_pairs_broken_seed0, but restricted to the glomeruli in the model's ORN input (36 for the APL16 odors). The boutons of the other glomeruli and the claws fed only by them are dropped first, so only claws and boutons with odor input are shuffled, and APL weights are scaled to mean 1 among them.

Which bouton feeds each claw is shuffled across claws, and so is how much each claw and each bouton gets from and gives to APL. A claw's (or bouton's) APL->X and X->APL weights are shuffled independently.
